== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Spiritual Origin test is a semi-annual [[ritual]] conducted by the clans of [[Sacred Valley]]. During this event, children between the ages of six and eight are evaluated by clan elders to reveal their inherent spiritual nature. Participants typically wear formal attire, such as layered robes for boys or shadesilk wraps for girls, while their parents observe the proceedings with anticipation. Although widely celebrated within the valley, some suggest the test is deceptive; rather than defining a person's ultimate potential, it merely identifies their starting discipline and natural strengths. For example, an individual identified as a [[Forger]] may face greater challenges when attempting to become an [[Enforcer]]. Outside of [[Sacred Valley]], true [[sacred artists]] are expected to master the four basic disciplines and harvest a [[Remnant]].}}
